# Dorian Award for TV Comedy of the Year

}}
The Dorian Award for TV Comedy of the Year is one of the main categories of Dorian Awards, given annually to the best TV comedy series of the year by GALECA: The Society of LGBTQ Entertainment Critics since 2010 (the group was initially named the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association).
The Dorians go to both mainstream and LGBTQ-centric content. Transparent and Hacks hold the record for most wins, with three each, followed by Glee, Girls, ''Schitt's Creek and Abbott Elementary, with two wins each. Modern Family holds the record for most nominations, with six.
